pathway.title: Cross-domain maintenance track (MTX)
steps: Prefer when triage spans Perf + Verify (+ Design/Deliver); OFP5-only when precision hub alone suffices
Optional domain=perf|verify|design|deliver filter — empty filtered set ≠ green
Follow nextMcpSequence (OFP5 / Perf / MRI / RWR as needed)
whenToUse: Issues + surfaces (or MRI/RWR) need one surgical list
After MRI remediate when multi-desk work remains
After OFP5 when agents start inventing parallel trackers
preferOverOfp5Only: Need Perf fix-queue rows beside Verify fingerprints
Need MRI/RWR pointers on the same track
Need domain/stage labels for surgical ordering
domainFilters: domain=perf — structural surface / API / data rows
Missing hubs with filter → empty rows; emptyGreen stays false
stageHonesty: triage — unknown / cold / decide next desk
prove — Verify ladder / ARP / stress before ship cite
remediate — finite surgical fix (MRI remediate path)
parked — rewrite/design hold; not abandoned silently
Stages are labels, not a workflow engine

links.note: OFP5 hub — fingerprint rows linked without minting duplicates

nextMcpSequence.purpose: Build OFP5 precision hub before trusting track issues
Populate Perf fix-queue when structural surfaces matter
Read register rows without inventing a second tracker

openQuestions: No issue-precision hub — run issue_precision_evaluate (OFP5) when tracking issues
No Perf fix-queue — run perf_explore_run when structural surface audit is needed
doesNotProve: MTX track pack is not a Jira replacement
MTX does not prove product fixed or live CDP
MTX does not mutate subject repos or rebuild registers
MTX does not claim Design ZIP / Deliver apply
Empty track rows with missing hubs ≠ green clearance
notes: MTX1/MTX2 cross-domain track: prefer this over inventing parallel issue lists
Composed 0 track rows from hubs only (no explore/CDP forced)
emptyGreen=false — missing hubs never imply all-clear
